headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Add grant conditions for two Office of Recovery grants into a budget order
meeting.summary: The committee recommended passing fiscal year 27 budget bills and Bill 76 on water system fees on first reading.
meeting.recap: The committee met to finish the fiscal year 27 budget.[[0:03:00]] Members voted to accept fringe benefit cuts matching police and public works cuts.[[0:04:57]] Staff read conditions for two Office of Recovery grants tied to West Maui.[[0:05:35]] Members approved the grant conditions with nine ayes.[[0:07:14]] Members voted to fix a fund's name in the budget appendix.[[0:09:26]] Members voted to place a farmers market fee exemption more clearly in the appendix, with one member recused.[[0:11:05]] The chair moved to reconsider (take back) sending Bill 76, on water system development fees, to another committee.[[0:19:18]] The chair said that committee could not review it in time to pass before fiscal year 27.[[0:19:32]] Members recommended passing Bill 76 on first reading with nine ayes.[[0:22:18]] That motion passed with nine ayes.[[0:25:56]] The committee's meeting set for tomorrow was canceled.[[0:27:38]] A member said $218,086.15 must be found before first reading to grant a testifier's requested tax rates.[[0:32:08]] The budget director said about $108,000 from property tax changes went into the Open Space Fund.[[0:37:41]]
decided: Members voted to add conditions describing how two Office of Recovery grants may be used.
Members recommended passing Bill 76 on first reading with any non-substantive revisions.

issues.oneLine: The committee moved Bill 76, on water system development fees, forward instead of sending it to another committee.
issues.why: The chair said the other committee would not have time to review the bill before second reading and the start of fiscal year 27.
issues.brief: On Friday, the committee had recommended sending Bill 76 to another committee.[[#1]] Members voted nine ayes to reconsider that referral.[[#2]] Members recommended passing Bill 76 on first reading with nine ayes.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The committee added conditions spelling out how two Office of Recovery grants may be used.
issues.why: One grant must fund planning so a Cameron Center in West Maui has a plan ready when a build-ready site is available.
issues.brief: The other grant must be used for cultural education, cultural monitoring, and support for West Maui rebuilding.[[#1]] The member who requested the conditions said they could not say whether the organizations were consulted.[[#2]] The conditions passed with nine ayes.[[#3]]
